marketLayer.title: US Tech & AI Infrastructure
marketLayer.fact: Major US technology firms report sustained capital expenditure growth in AI infrastructure, with cloud service segments showing double-digit revenue expansion.
marketLayer.inference: Semiconductor manufacturers and data center component suppliers are likely to maintain strong order visibility in the near to medium term.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Risk of power grid bottlenecks delaying data center deployments and investor scrutiny over long-term return on AI investments.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Platform & E-Commerce
marketLayer.fact: Hang Seng Tech Index stocks show stabilized valuations supported by ongoing corporate share buybacks and enhanced AI-driven monetization strategies.
marketLayer.inference: Share repurchase programs provide a downside cushion for major internet heavyweights, though aggressive promotional spending caps immediate profit margin upside.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Uncertainty surrounding domestic consumer confidence recovery and potential international trade policy friction for cross-border platforms.

marketLayer.title: Fed Policy & Rate-Sensitive Assets
marketLayer.fact: US economic indicators point toward moderating labor tightness and cooling inflation, fueling market expectations for incoming interest rate adjustments.
marketLayer.inference: High-yielding HK dividend stocks and US rate-sensitive sectors (such as REITs and utilities) may attract rebalancing capital flows as Treasury yields ease.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential sticky core service inflation components pushing back the timing or pace of monetary policy easing.
